    AI Overview
    The 2026 NHL regular season concludes on April 16, with the Stanley Cup Playoffs expected to begin on April 18, 2026. As of April 11, teams like the Colorado Avalanche, Dallas Stars, Minnesota Wild, and Edmonton Oilers have clinched playoff spots, with first-round matchups for the Western Conference beginning to take shape. 
    Key 2026 Playoff Information 
    • Start Date: Tentatively April 18, 2026, directly following the April 16 end of the regular season.
    • Format: Four rounds of best-of-seven series (2–2–1–1–1 format), with 16 teams total qualifying.
    • Clinching Teams (as of April 11): Avalanche, Stars, Wild, Oilers, and Golden Knights have secured berths.
    • Projected Matchups: Potential first-round matchups include Colorado vs. Los Angeles and Dallas vs. Minnesota. 
    Clinching Scenarios & Standings (April 11-12) 
    • Western Conference: The Avalanche hold the top Central spot, with the Stars securing the No. 2 seed. The Oilers and Golden Knights are battling for top Pacific spots.
    • Eastern Conference: The Buffalo Sabres, Carolina Hurricanes, and others are in contention for top spots, with the Red Wings recently eliminated. 
    For the most up-to-date daily matchup times and bracket changes, visit the official NHL schedule or PlayoffStatus.com.

    AI Overview
    The 2026 NHL Stanley Cup Playoffs are scheduled to begin on Saturday, April 18, 2026. The regular season concludes on Thursday, April 16, leading directly into the first round of the postseason. Sixteen teams—eight from each conference—will compete for the Stanley Cup. 
    Key 2026 Playoff Details: 
    • Start Date: Saturday, April 18, 2026.
    • Format: Top three teams from each division plus two wild card teams per conference.
    • Coverage: Games will be available on ESPN, NHL on TNT, Sportsnet, and TVA Sports.
    • Finals: The Stanley Cup Final is expected to conclude by late June. 
    Note: The official 2026 playoff bracket and match-ups will be finalized after the regular season concludes on April 16.
